summary: Adds a new skill file skills/p-review/SKILL.md. It defines a single-pass adversarial review: the conductor establishes artifact, baseline, and intent, dispatches one fresh subagent with a verbatim reviewer brief, then rules on findings and presents them as Concerns, Noted, Rejected, and Minor. Findings are rated /10. An --inline flag skips the subagent and the Ruling step. Minor findings go to a minor-findings.md file for a downstream auto-fix agent.

claims.text: Skill always dispatches a fresh subagent as Reviewer unless --inline is passed.
Baseline resolves via git merge-base HEAD @{u}, falling back to origin/HEAD, then asks the user.
Reviewer must not surface issues a compiler, linter, or existing tests would catch.
Ruling rejects a finding only when it rests on a false premise; other findings stay.
Minor list is written verbatim to minor-findings.md beside the artifact, or at repo root, never printed.
Description claims this pass is cheaper than debate-review and adversarial-review skills.

risks.note: git merge-base HEAD @{u} on a branch behind upstream diffs against merge-base, not upstream tip; intended?
minor-findings.md overwrites silently on repeated runs; no naming or append rule given.
Overlaps debate-review, adversarial-review, adversarial-review-2; boundary is only stated in description prose.

least_confident: I cannot check whether the referenced sibling skills (debate-review, adversarial-review, adversarial-review-2) exist or how their triggers overlap with this description.
